predictions.rationale: Defines the Critic agent abstraction itself, including trigger, predicate, and suggestion generation logic—core of Design Critics feature.
Maintains the registry of Critic objects and manages their life-cycle and execution, i.e., the ‘simple agents that continuously execute’.
Implements the standard control mechanism that schedules/dispatches critics over the model in the background thread.
Base class/interface for control mechanisms; defines how critics are invoked and filtered during automated analysis.
Provides a composite critic that groups several critics together, supporting more complex analysis suggestions.
Represents the current designer context passed to critics for evaluation, enabling personalized critique.
Subsystem initializer that boots the critic infrastructure at application start, wiring the background thread.
Encapsulates individual critic findings (suggestions/errors) shown to the user, directly supporting feedback delivery.
Aggregates ToDoItems, managing the list of active critiques that the designer must address.
UI action that toggles automatic critique execution, linking user control to the background critic thread.
